name: Aldebaran
summary: Aldebaran created the NAO and Pepper humanoids, selling about 20,000 NAO and 17,000 Pepper units. After its 2025 bankruptcy, Shenzhen-based Maxvision bought its core assets and IP.
funding: Formerly owned by SoftBank; core assets acquired by Maxvision Technology in July 2025.

sources.title: Maxvision buys core robot assets of Aldebaran, including Nao and Pepper
